name: Lanzhou Zhongchuan International Airport
before:
The airport for Lanzhou, capital of Gansu province, and a hub for the province and for western China. It carried 17.7 million passengers in 2025, ranking 29th busiest in China.

The distance is the headline. It is 71 km north west of downtown Lanzhou, which is a long way by any standard, so a transfer here needs real time allowed for it.

The airport is essentially brand new inside. Terminal 3 opened on 20 March 2025 and took over all flights from the two older terminals. At 400,000 square metres with 87 gates across four piers, it dwarfs its predecessors, and has a ground transportation centre attached. Terminal 2 closed for renovation and is expected to become a cargo terminal.

Any guidance referring to Terminal 1 or Terminal 2 for passenger flights is now out of date.

It is a focus city for China Eastern, Spring Airlines and Hainan Airlines, and opened in 1970.
after:

The distance is the headline. It is 71 km north west of downtown Lanzhou, which is a long way by any standard, so a transfer here needs real time allowed for it.

The airport is essentially brand new inside. Terminal 3 opened on 20 March 2025 and took over all flights from the two older terminals. At 400,000 square metres, with four piers, it dwarfs its predecessors and has a ground transportation centre attached.

Any guidance referring to Terminal 1 or Terminal 2 for passenger flights is now out of date.

It opened in 1970.

Wikipedia's current revision (14 September 2026) says it opened on that day. No source from the last 12 months outside Wikipedia could be read: the operator's site (lzzcairport.com, OurAirports' home link) failed to connect, Xinhua's Gansu index answered 502, the Gansu transport department answered 412 with an empty page, and the CAAC Gansu regulator's 2026 items do not name a terminal. The same pairing was accepted for Urumqi's 2025 terminal move.

claims.why: Held back: the old text never mentions the railway, so this replaces nothing, but it matters for a 71 km transfer. China Railway lists a Zhongchuan Airport East station (中川机场东) under Lanzhou, Gansu Daily says the third phase joined rail and road to the airport, and Wikipedia says the station serves Terminal 3 with trains to Lanzhou West in 38 minutes (the journey time is Wikipedia's alone). Was to read: "Trains run from Zhongchuan Airport East station, beside Terminal 3, into Lanzhou."
